text.p: Furman Selz said on Monday it cut its first quarter earnings estimate on shares of 3Com Corp to $0.46 per share from $0.48 per share, based on modest revenue growth expectations and sequential gross margin decline.
-- Analyst Martin Pyykkonen said in a research note he forecast modest sequential revenue growth of 4.4 percent to $1.573 billion in the first quarter.
-- The estimate cut reduced his 1998 earnings estimate to $2.33 per share from $2.35 per share, he said. Pyykkonen maintained his neutral rating on the stock.

-- "We estimate a sequential decline of 0.9 points in gross margin, largely due to pricing in NICs (network interface cards) and still another quarter to go before 3Com's next generation and lower cost NIC is available, as well as a sequentially tough comparison on U.S. Robotic gross margin," Pyykkonen said.
-- 3Com and U.S. Robotics completed their merger in June.
